containers.name: caj-develocrm-migrations-pilot
args: import pg from 'pg'; const c=new pg.Client({connectionString:process.env.DATABASE_URL}); await c.connect(); try { await c.query('BEGIN READ ONLY'); const prices=await c.query("SELECT p.code project,u.code unit,(SELECT count(*)::int FROM unit_price_history h WHERE h.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND h.unit_id=u.id) history_count, CASE WHEN EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM unit_price_history h WHERE h.tenant_id=u.tenant_id AND h.unit_id=u.id AND h.valid_from<=now()) THEN app.current_unit_price(u.tenant_id,u.id,now())::text END current_price FROM units u JOIN projects p ON p.id=u.project_id AND p.tenant_id=u.tenant_id WHERE u.tenant_id=$1 AND u.archived_at IS NULL ORDER BY p.code,u.code",['60bed28c-0c89-4a38-bac7-71e6cf7b9232']); const signed=await c.query("SELECT p.code project,u.code unit,c.contract_type type,cv.version_number version,cv.document_version_id IS NOT NULL has_document FROM contracts c JOIN projects p ON p.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND p.id=c.project_id JOIN units u ON u.tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND u.id=c.unit_id LEFT JOIN LATERAL(SELECT version_number,document_version_id FROM contract_versions WHERE tenant_id=c.tenant_id AND contract_id=c.id ORDER BY version_number DESC LIMIT 1) cv ON true WHERE c.tenant_id=$1 AND c.current_status='signed' ORDER BY p.code,u.code",['60bed28c-0c89-4a38-bac7-71e6cf7b9232']); console.log(JSON.stringify({event:'price_document_integrity.read_only_audit',prices:prices.rows,signed:signed.rows})); await c.query('ROLLBACK'); } finally { await c.end(); }
